description:
The General Services Administration (GSA) is seeking qualified contractors to perform concrete repair services at three federal facilities in Montana. Work includes structural concrete repairs to stairways, sidewalks, ADA-compliant ramps, and building exteriors.

1. James F. Battin Federal Courthouse - Billings, MT

  • Primary Work : Parking garage stairway repairs
  • Key Tasks :
    • Comprehensive damage assessment
    • Repair cracks, spalling, and chipped stair treads
    • Rebar cleaning/replacement as needed
    • Surface leveling for smooth transitions

2. Bozeman USPS and Federal Building - Bozeman, MT

  • Primary Work : Perimeter sidewalk and ADA ramp repairs
  • Key Tasks :
    • Full exterior walkway assessment
    • Concrete repair including truncated dome surfaces
    • Root damage mitigation
    • Surface leveling and transitions

3. Mike Mansfield Federal Building - Butte, MT

  • Primary Work : Selective concrete patching
  • Key Tasks :
    • Remove deteriorated concrete to sound base
    • Rebar restoration or replacement with epoxy anchoring
    • Bonding agent application and patching
    • Match existing finishes

Common Requirements Across All Sites

  • Obtain all necessary permits and licenses
  • Perform thorough pre-work assessments
  • Execute standard concrete repair procedures: saw cutting, excavation, subgrade prep, forming, reinforcement, finishing, and curing
  • Ensure smooth transitions and proper surface levels
  • Address any exposed or damaged reinforcing steel
